title: Zesty Poached Canadian Kielbasa Tagine
description: A light and cozy Canadian dish featuring poached kielbasa, perfect for a cold winter night, made with low sodium ingredients for a healthier option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay tagine over medium heat.
Add the sliced kielbasa and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the chicken broth, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, and paprika to the tagine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the chopped parsley to the tagine and stir to combine.
Poach the kielbasa in the simmering broth for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the poached kielbasa hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the tagine cool before washing and storing.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use.
Reheat the tagine over low heat before serving.
